description: An agent-signed Proposal, for a Gate to assert its signing against. The private key is SHA-256 of private_key_seed (UTF-8 bytes) read as a big-endian integer; it is a test key, published here, and signs nothing real. The signature is deterministic (RFC 6979), so a correct signer reproduces agent_signature byte for byte. The did is a test identity: its SCID is the base58btc SHA-256 multihash of the UTF-8 string "bindable agent-signed proposal test vector, scid", not of a DID log entry, so it resolves nowhere.
private_key_seed: bindable agent-signed proposal test vector, key 1
signature_encoding: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256, deterministic (RFC 6979), DER, base64 (RFC 4648 section 4, padded)
